gates.name: Type Safety & Interface Signatures
gates.rule: Verify complete type contract enforcement and parameter compatibility
gates.test_verification: Verified: Untyped or type-violating signatures rejected at Gate T

gates.name: Unit & Behavioral Tests
gates.rule: Evaluate test suite execution with assertion_ratio >= 1.0 and zero failed tests
gates.test_verification: Verified: Behavioral test failure or low assertion ratio rejected at Gate U

gates.name: Static & Contract Analysis
gates.rule: Evaluate static analyzer violations (static_violations == 0) and contract verification
gates.test_verification: Verified: Memory safety or lint violations rejected at Gate S

gates.name: Latency & SLA Contract
gates.rule: Evaluate observed execution latency <= SLA budget with strict tolerance
gates.test_verification: Verified: Execution exceeding latency SLA bound rejected at Gate L

gates.name: Concurrency & Fault Invariants
gates.rule: Evaluate race condition freedom, linearizability, and fault tolerance invariants
gates.test_verification: Verified: Race condition or split-brain vulnerability rejected at Gate F

epistemic_hierarchy.empty_evidence_rule: source_code_exists != software_capability_certified. Empty evidence leaves status at SOURCE_SPECIFIED and yields UNVERIFIED, never CERTIFIED

authority_tier_enforcement.rule: A component requiring higher authority than the calling environment is rejected fail-closed
